EXAMPLE for a fictional habit-tracker app ('Habitude') — /onboard generates the real features.json at the repo root from the PRD. One entry per FR; passes flips to true only when the evidence file exists in evidence/ (bare path here, as in F-001; the justification goes in PROGRESS.md).

features.title: Create a habit
features.description: From the home screen, the user can create a habit with a name and a repeat schedule (daily or specific weekdays); the new habit appears in the home list immediately.

features.title: Check off today
features.description: The user can mark a habit as done for today with one tap on its row; the row shows a completed state and the action can be undone the same day.

features.title: Streak counter
features.description: Each habit row shows its current streak (consecutive scheduled days completed); the streak increments on check-off and resets to zero when a scheduled day passes without completion.

features.title: Edit and delete habits
features.description: The user can rename a habit, change its schedule, or delete it after a confirmation step; history of past completions is preserved on edit.

features.title: Daily reminder
features.description: The user can enable one daily reminder time per habit; a local notification fires at that time on scheduled days and deep-links to the habit on tap.

features.title: Weekly progress view
features.description: A progress screen shows the last 7 days as a grid of habits versus days, with per-habit completion counts and an overall completion percentage for the week.

features.title: Multi-device sync
features.description: Habits and completions sync across the user's devices; a change made on one device appears on another within a minute when both are online, with offline changes merged on reconnect.

features.title: Home screen widget
features.description: A home screen widget shows today's habits and their completion state; tapping the widget opens the app on the home list.
